entries.definition: A small cake baked in a usually paper container shaped like a cup, often with icing on top.
A person, typically someone other than a family member, spouse or lover, whose company one enjoys and towards whom one feels affection.
The mother of one's spouse.
Do not (negative auxiliary).
An item of information put into a temporary or permanent physical medium.

A heavy, pliable, inelastic metal element, having a bright, bluish color, but easily tarnished; both malleable and ductile, though with little tenacity. It is easily fusible, forms alloys with other metals, and is an ingredient of solder and type metal. Atomic number 82.
To look at and interpret letters or other information that is written.
To be alive; to have life.
To remove or block an opening, gap or passage through.
A t that has p e but is not alive.
Relating to now, for the time being; current.
Satisfied, pleased, contented.
A barren area of land or desolate terrain, especially one with little water or vegetation; a wasteland.
To bring forth, to yield, make, manufacture, or otherwise generate.

An inorganic compound (of molecular formula) found at room temperature and pressure as a clear liquid; it is present naturally as rain, and found in rivers, lakes and seas; its solid form is ice and its gaseous form is steam.
Plural of person.
A group of people who are closely related to one another (by blood, marriage or adoption); kin; in particular, a set of parents and their children; an immediate family.
A generally accepted means of exchange.
A specific commercial enterprise or establishment.
An institution dedicated to teaching and learning; an educational institution.
A person who studies or learns about a particular subject.
A person who teaches, especially one employed in a school; preceptor.
A worded or expressed sentence, phrase, or only a word on its own, which asks for information, a reply, or a response; an interrogative.
A response or reply; something said or done in reaction to a statement or question.
A body of words, and set of methods of combining them (called a grammar), understood by a community and used as a form of communication.
The smallest unit of language that has a particular meaning and can be expressed by itself; the smallest discrete, meaningful unit of language.
A symbol in an alphabet.
Quantity of countable things.
A representation of anything (as a person, a landscape, a building) upon canvas, paper, or other surface, by drawing, painting, printing, photography, etc.

A programmable electronic device that performs mathematical calculations and logical operations, especially one that can process, store and retrieve large amounts of data very quickly; now especially, a small one for personal or home use employed for manipulating text or graphics, accessing the Internet, or playing games or media.

A telecommunication device which converts data or sounds (usually speech) into electrical signals which are then transmitted to enable two or more people to communicate with each other over a distance; now usually a device having a dial or keypad with numerals for entering a number, etc., to connect with a person, and means (such as a sound or vibration) for alerting one to an incoming call or transmission; also, the handset or receiver of such a device.
# Guidance; help.
A large settlement, bigger than a town; sometimes with a specific legal definition, depending on the place.
The territory of a nation; a sovereign state or a region once independent and still distinct in institutions, language, etc.
A contiguous area of land, smaller than a continent, totally surrounded by water.
An elevation of land of considerable dimensions rising more or less abruptly, forming a conspicuous figure in the landscape, usually having a small extent of surface at its summit.
The short-term state of the atmosphere at a specific time and place, including the temperature, relative humidity, cloud cover, precipitation, wind, etc.
The early part of the day, especially from midnight to noon.
The time of day between afternoon and night.
The anniversary of the day on which someone is born.
A day on which a religious event or secular celebration is traditionally observed.
An eating establishment in which diners are served food, usually by waiters at their tables but sometimes (as in a fast food restaurant) at a counter.
A large medical facility, usually in a building with multiple floors, where seriously ill or injured patients are given extensive medical or surgical treatment.
An institution which holds books and/or other forms of media for use by the public or qualified people often lending them out, as well as providing various other services for its users.
A room or area for preparing food.
An outdoor area containing one or more types of plants, usually plants grown for food or ornamental purposes.
An opening, usually covered by one or more panes of clear glass, to allow light and air from outside to enter a building or vehicle.
A container, typically made of glass or plastic and having a tapered neck, used primarily for holding liquids.
The elongated curved tropical fruit of a banana plant, which grows in bunches and has a creamy flesh and a smooth skin.
An evergreen tree of the genus Citrus such as which yields oranges (the fruit).
Any plant.
A food made from ground roasted cocoa beans.
The first meal of the day, usually eaten in the morning.
The main meal of the day, often eaten in the evening.
A beverage made by infusing the beans of the coffee plant in hot water.
A food consisting of small, sweet crystals, principally of sucrose, obtained from sugar cane or sugar beet and used as sweetener and preservative.
A soft, fatty foodstuff made by churning the cream of milk (generally cow's milk).

A utensil or a tool designed for cutting, consisting of a flat piece of hard material, usually steel or other metal (the blade), usually sharpened on one edge, attached to a handle. The blade may be pointed for piercing.
Items of clothing; apparel.
Plural of shoe.
A bag stitched to an item of clothing, used for carrying small items.
A device for taking still or moving pictures or photographs.
A series of sounds organized in time, usually employing some combination of harmony, melody, rhythm, tempo, timbre, sound design, lyrics, etc., often to convey a mood.
A recorded sequence of images displayed on a screen at a rate sufficiently fast to create the appearance of motion; a film; a video.
The spectral composition of visible light.

A multicellular organism of the kingdom that is usually mobile, with cells that are not encased in a rigid cell wall (distinguishing them from plants and fungi) and derives energy solely from the consumption of other organisms.
A large mammal of the family in the order, having a trunk, and native to Africa and Asia.
A flying insect of the order, distinguished from moths by their diurnal activity and generally brighter colouring.
One’s female offspring.
Son of the same parents as another person.
Standard American spelling of neighbour.

A physician; a member of the medical profession; one who is trained and licensed to heal the sick or injured. The final examination and qualification may award a doctor degree in which case the post-nominal letters are DO, DPM, MD, DMD, or DDS in the US, or MBBS or BDS in the UK.
# A soldier engaged in designing or constructing military works for attack or defence, or other engineering works.
To request or petition.
To start, to initiate or take the first step into something.
To accept as true, particularly without absolute certainty (i.e., as opposed to knowing).
To transport toward somebody/somewhere.
To obtain (something) in exchange for money or goods.
To pick; to make the choice of; to select.
To discover, find out; to uncover.
Sufficient; all that is required, needed, or appropriate.
To make plain, manifest, or intelligible; to clear of obscurity; to illustrate the meaning of.
An end; the end of anything.
To go after; to pursue; to move behind in the same path or direction, especially with the intent of catching.
To form a mental image of something; to envision or create something in one's mind.
To use one's sense of hearing and auditory cognition in an intentional way; to make deliberate use of one's ears; to pay attention to or wait for a specific sound.
A prescribed quantity or extent.
An oath or affirmation; a vow.
To recall from one's memory; to have an image in one's memory.
To imply but stop short of explicitly stating (something).
A representation created in the mind without the use of one's faculties of vision, sound, smell, touch, or taste; an instance of thinking.
From one side or end of (something) to the other.
To be on a journey, often for pleasure or business and with luggage; to go from one place to another.
To know the meaning of; to parse or have parsed correctly; to comprehend.
To habitually go to (someone in distress, sickness etc.) to comfort them. (Now generally merged into later senses, below.)
To move on the feet by alternately setting each foot (or pair or group of feet, in the case of animals with four or more feet) forward, with at least one foot on the ground at all times. Compare run.
A portable or wearable timepiece.
# Labour, occupation, job.
To form letters, words or symbols on a surface in order to communicate.
Possessing beauty, impressing the eye; attractive.
Crowded with business or activities; having a great deal going on.
Taking care; attentive to potential danger, error or harm; cautious.
Providing physical comfort and ease; agreeable.
Full of danger.
Not the same; exhibiting a difference.
Hard, not easy, requiring much effort.
At a time in advance of the usual or expected event.
In the public eye.
Standard American spelling of favourite.
Having relevant and crucial value; having import.
Of concern; affecting, important.
Required, essential, whether logically inescapable or needed in order to achieve a desired result or avoid some penalty.
With little or no sound; free of disturbing noise.
Without humor or expression of happiness; grave in manner or disposition.
Not normal; odd, unusual, surprising, out of the ordinary, often with a negative connotation.
Dreadful; causing terror, alarm and fear; awesome
less than always, but more than occasionally.
Tending to excite wonder; surprising, extraordinary.
By or for the cause that; on this account that; for the reason that.
One more further, in addition to the quantity by then; a second or additional one, similar in likeness or in effect.
At the same time, in the same place; in close association or proximity.
Which of two.
Plural of woman.
Plural of child.
